column1: # The minimum set of JIP LN NVSE commands that must have a handler before nv-rs answers "JIP LN NVSE is installed"
# (`jip::ANSWERS_INSTALLED`, ADR-0016). Names only, as JIP registers them (long name or alias, case does
# not matter). Checked by `minimum::tests`: a name with no handler fails the gate while the flag is on.
# Columns: name, source, group (the JIP source file the command is in).
# Source `scan` is a measured entry: the missing JIP LN commands called most (by call sites) in a scan of the
# compiled scripts of the owner's installed list (`nvmod nvse-usage`; numbers only, no plugin names). This
# Version 2 holds the 40 most called of the 134 missing there. Source `analysis` would be an estimate from
